epics.title: Identity, authentication, onboarding, and sessions
epics.rationale: Every protected conversion depends on reliable identity and recovery.

epics.title: Profiles, multi-role identities, portfolios, and public pages
epics.rationale: Profiles drive discovery while exposing ownership and privacy boundaries.

epics.title: Search and discovery
epics.rationale: Discoverability is the entry to audience, lead, and revenue journeys.

epics.title: Community, contacts, messaging, events, and collaboration
epics.rationale: Multi-user interactions create moderation and isolation risks.

epics.title: Studio services, reservations, orders, sessions, and Live Sessions
epics.rationale: Scheduling conflicts and incomplete payment state directly affect operations and revenue.

epics.title: School, courses, trials, registrations, schedules, and attendance
epics.rationale: Seat inventory, schedules, student privacy, and minor consent intersect.

epics.title: Marketplace sales, rentals, availability, tracking, cancellations, and disputes
epics.rationale: Money, inventory, custody, deposits, and multi-party ownership must remain consistent.

epics.title: Public events, tickets, checkout, issuance, and validation
epics.rationale: Public conversion and fraud-resistant entry depend on authoritative ticket state.

epics.title: Provider payments, callbacks, webhooks, retries, refunds, and reconciliation
epics.rationale: Incorrect authority or idempotency can cause duplicate charges or financial misstatement.

epics.title: Domo discovery, quotes, availability, booking, and follow-up
epics.rationale: A public lead must retain context through quote, deposit, booking, and operations.

epics.title: CRM contacts, companies, leads, activities, assignments, and conversion
epics.rationale: Lead provenance and assignment affect conversion and private contact data.

epics.title: Label, releases, assets, tracks, DDEX, partners, delivery, and status
epics.rationale: Rights, unreleased media, metadata, and external delivery failures carry contractual risk.

epics.title: Inventory, equipment bookings, assignments, maintenance, and custody
epics.rationale: Availability and custody must prevent unsafe or conflicting operations.

epics.title: Finance, reports, refunds, reconciliation, and audit trails
epics.rationale: Financial state requires verified evidence, dual control, and durable auditability.

epics.title: Administration, roles, settings, CMS, diagnostics, and integrations
epics.rationale: Administrative errors can affect every user and must be backend-enforced.

epics.title: Accessibility, localization, privacy, help, and recovery
epics.rationale: Inclusive, comprehensible recovery determines whether journeys are independently completable.

epics.title: Public-to-operational-to-financial cross-epic lifecycles
epics.rationale: Revenue is realized only when public intent reaches operations and reconciliation without state gaps.

PER-01.title: Register from a protected intent and recover an expired session
PER-01.journey: Start from a protected call to action, register through the UI, verify locally, let the session expire, recover the account, and return to the original intent.

PER-01.title: Explore Quito and Cuenca content without an account
PER-01.journey: Use public navigation and search with city, profession, genre, event, and venue terms without scripted navigation.

PER-01.title: Inspect and hold a public ticket without signing in
PER-01.journey: Open a public event offer, compare tiers, accept versioned terms, create an isolated guest hold, review the server total, and confirm that a hold is neither payment nor issuance.
PER-01.permission: public storefront and capability-scoped guest order

PER-02.title: Complete a fan profile and log out safely
PER-02.journey: Complete required profile fields, select consent preferences, log out, and verify protected state is no longer recoverable from history.

PER-02.title: Purchase, retrieve, and validate a ticket
PER-02.journey: Select a tier, create a hold, complete a sandbox payment, retrieve the issued ticket on another device, and validate it once.

PER-02.title: Recover from a cancelled payment sheet
PER-02.journey: Cancel the sandbox payment sheet, verify the reservation is released, retry with the same intent, and wait for verified provider evidence.

PER-03.title: Discover an artist and event entirely in English
PER-03.journey: Navigate public home, directory, artist, venue, and event pages in English and retain locale across links.

PER-03.title: Track a cross-border refund without assuming browser success
PER-03.journey: Request cancellation, see pending refund state, receive verified provider update, and confirm final status and audit timeline.

PER-03.title: Use contrast-safe, non-color status communication
PER-03.journey: Review order and refund states with high contrast and simulated deuteranopia, using text and icons rather than color alone.

PER-04.title: Complete and submit an artist profile
PER-04.journey: Edit biography, roles, city, genres, portfolio and consent; preview privately; submit; then verify the public projection.

PER-04.title: Book a studio session through confirmed completion
PER-04.journey: Choose service, room and time, create a hold, pay in sandbox, confirm reservation, attend the session, and close the order.

PER-04.title: Submit a fictional EP for distribution validation
PER-04.journey: Create release, add tracks and contributors, upload fake assets, run validation, correct errors, approve, and stop before external delivery.

PER-05.title: Compose Artist and Producer capabilities predictably
PER-05.journey: Sign in once, inspect role-specific destinations, perform an owned artist edit and assigned producer action, then attempt an unrelated record.

PER-05.title: Find collaborators with persistent filters
PER-05.journey: Search by city, profession, role and genre; open a result; return; save the search; and continue on another device.

PER-05.title: Invite a collaborator without exposing private projects
PER-05.journey: Create a collaboration request, invite one artist, accept as the counterpart, exchange scoped messages, and close the collaboration.

PER-06.title: Find a drummer despite terminology differences
PER-06.journey: Search using colloquial and formal Spanish terms, filter by Loja and remote work, and compare result relevance.

PER-06.title: Publish a classified and manage applications
PER-06.journey: Create a draft, preview, publish, receive a fictional application, accept one applicant, reject another, and archive the post.
PER-06.permission: owner manages; applicants see own response

PER-06.title: Block and report unwanted contact
PER-06.journey: Block a fictional contact, report the interaction with minimal evidence, confirm messaging stops, and inspect recovery guidance.
PER-06.permission: own safety controls; moderators only see case

PER-07.title: Plan and complete an assigned production session
PER-07.journey: Convert an assigned lead into a quote, reserve resources, assign staff, complete the session, and close its operational pipeline.

PER-07.title: Qualify and convert an assigned lead
PER-07.journey: Open only an assigned lead, record consented activity, qualify it, convert it to customer and opportunity, and preserve provenance.

PER-07.title: Review a release package as A&R
PER-07.journey: Inspect contributors, rights and assets; return actionable validation findings; approve a corrected package; and verify history.

PER-08.title: Inspect an assigned artist contract with keyboard only
PER-08.journey: Navigate to an assigned artist and contract with keyboard landmarks, review access history, then attempt an unassigned contract URL.

PER-08.title: Validate, import, and deliver a DDEX record
PER-08.journey: Import a synthetic DDEX document, deduplicate entities, fix validation errors, approve delivery, and use a fake partner adapter.
PER-08.permission: assigned catalog; delivery approval as configured

PER-08.title: Confirm finance remains unavailable to A&R
PER-08.journey: Attempt finance navigation, a direct report URL, and corresponding API endpoints while retaining legitimate catalog access.

PER-09.title: Publish course availability and manage its lifecycle
PER-09.journey: Create course schedule, publish seats, receive registrations, teach sessions, record attendance, and close the course.

PER-09.title: Maintain separate teacher and artist profile contexts
PER-09.journey: Edit teaching specialties and artist portfolio, preview both public projections, and verify fields do not leak between contexts.

PER-09.title: Restrict teacher access to assigned students
PER-09.journey: Review assigned roster and attendance, then attempt another teacher's student through search, direct URL, and API.

PER-10.title: Create a minor account with fictional guardian approval
PER-10.journey: Begin registration, provide minimum fictional data, send consent to a local inbox, approve as the fictional guardian, and activate the account.
PER-10.permission: pending account then consented own account

PER-10.title: Request and attend a trial lesson
PER-10.journey: Browse a public course, request an available trial, obtain guardian approval, schedule with a teacher, attend, and convert to enrollment.

PER-10.title: Protect a minor on a shared device
PER-10.journey: Sign out, navigate browser history, reopen the app, and verify sensitive schedule and message data require fresh authentication.

PER-11.title: Complete and resubmit an assigned internship task
PER-11.journey: Open an assigned task, save an interrupted draft, submit fake evidence, receive revision feedback, resubmit, and close it.

PER-11.title: View operational context without changing inventory
PER-11.journey: Open an assignment-linked equipment record, inspect safe context, and attempt create, edit, delete, and export operations.
PER-11.permission: read only when assignment grants it

PER-11.title: Reject intern access to administration
PER-11.journey: Attempt menu discovery, search, direct admin route, user API, diagnostics, and integration settings.

PER-12.title: Create a customer booking and hand it to operations
PER-12.journey: Find/create customer, quote an available service, place a reservation, collect no raw card data, confirm sandbox evidence, and hand off the session.
PER-12.permission: CRM and scheduling; no finance approval

PER-12.title: Capture and convert a public inquiry
PER-12.journey: Receive a fictional public inquiry, verify consent/source, assign activity, qualify it, convert it, and preserve the public attribution.

PER-12.title: Trace a lead through booking and reconciliation
PER-12.journey: Follow one correlation ID from public lead through quote, booking, payment evidence, session completion, invoice, and accounting reconciliation.

PER-13.title: Resolve a room conflict with an audited override
PER-13.journey: Detect overlapping holds, reject unsafe overwrite, select an alternative or enter an authorized reasoned override, notify parties, and close the session.

PER-13.title: Assign staff and equipment through return
PER-13.journey: Assign available staff and equipment, record checkout, reassign a conflict, record return condition, and close custody.

PER-13.title: Reconcile operational and revenue reports
PER-13.journey: Compare session, booking, invoice, provider evidence and refund records, investigate a mismatch, reconcile it, and export a sanitized report.

PER-14.title: Block damaged equipment until verified repair
PER-14.journey: Report damage with fake evidence, change item to unavailable, reject new reservations, complete repair, verify condition, and restore availability.

PER-14.title: Prevent booking unsafe inventory
PER-14.journey: Attempt to reserve a service requiring blocked equipment from UI and direct API, then choose a safe alternative and complete the reservation.
PER-14.permission: read scheduling context; no customer order ownership

PER-14.title: Recover a maintenance draft after connectivity loss
PER-14.journey: Enter a condition report, lose connectivity before submission, reopen, review preserved data, submit once, and confirm status without color dependence.

PER-15.title: Preview and publish bilingual CMS content
PER-15.journey: Draft Spanish and English content, preview without public visibility, validate links, publish once, inspect audit, and roll back to the prior version.

PER-15.title: Inspect diagnostics without exposing secrets
PER-15.journey: Open status and integration diagnostics, search rendered content and API payloads for secret-shaped values, and verify actionable but safe errors.

PER-15.title: Verify published content across public entry points
PER-15.journey: Open the published item from home, search and direct URL in both locales and representative viewports, then verify rollback consistency.

PER-16.title: Assign and revoke multi-role access
PER-16.journey: Assign fictional roles, verify exact modules, revoke one role, expire sessions, verify denial in UI/direct URL/API, and inspect the audit trail.

PER-16.title: Replay a failed sandbox provider event safely
PER-16.journey: Inspect an encrypted dedupe record, replay one failed sandbox event, prevent duplicate effects, and reconcile the target order.
PER-16.permission: strict admin or configured finance operator

PER-16.title: Review security events with screen-reader semantics
PER-16.journey: Navigate audit filters, status and detail dialogs using screen-reader landmarks and keyboard, export a sanitized subset, and close focus correctly.

PER-17.title: Claim and verify a fictional venue page
PER-17.journey: Submit a venue claim with fake evidence, keep changes private during review, approve as moderator, update owned details, and revoke the claim.

PER-17.title: Publish discoverable, accurate venue availability
PER-17.journey: Set public attributes and non-sensitive availability, discover by city/service, open the venue detail, and verify private contact data stays hidden.

PER-17.title: Respond to a venue-service inquiry
PER-17.journey: Receive a fictional inquiry, quote availability, accept a booking request, track order, handle cancellation, and close follow-up.

PER-18.title: Rent equipment through custody and return
PER-18.journey: Search availability, request dates, accept quote, fund sandbox deposit, record handoff, return with condition evidence, and close the rental.

PER-18.title: Separate deposit authorization from final charge
PER-18.journey: Authorize a fake deposit, verify it is not reported as revenue, complete return, release or partially capture through verified evidence, and reconcile.

PER-18.title: Track deposit release and refund
PER-18.journey: Follow pending, submitted, provider-confirmed and reconciled states with timestamps and support guidance.

PER-19.title: Create and operate an equipment listing
PER-19.journey: Draft listing, upload fake images, publish, receive request, approve, hand off, receive return, settle dispute if needed, and archive.

PER-19.title: Preserve immutable handoff evidence
PER-19.journey: Capture fake condition evidence and mutual acknowledgement at handoff and return, then verify later edits append rather than replace history.

PER-19.title: Understand seller settlement and cancellation
PER-19.journey: Cancel within and outside policy, inspect fee/refund split, complete a clean rental, and reconcile seller settlement to provider evidence.

PER-20.title: Publish and operate a fictional event
PER-20.journey: Draft event, assign venue and collaborators, validate required details, publish, update, cancel one occurrence, and archive after completion.

PER-20.title: Issue and validate tickets exactly once
PER-20.journey: Publish tiers, sell sandbox tickets, deliver through a fake adapter, validate at entry, reject replay, refund one ticket, and close sales.

PER-20.title: Reconcile event orders, refunds, and payout
PER-20.journey: Compare issued and validated tickets to orders and verified provider events, resolve mismatch, account for refund, and produce a sanitized closeout.

PER-21.title: Deliver a synthetic release and correct a rejection
PER-21.journey: Complete release metadata, validate fake assets, approve, deliver through a fake partner, receive rejection, correct one field, redeliver idempotently, and reach terminal status.

PER-21.title: Pay a distribution order without duplicate charge
PER-21.journey: Create quote and order, cancel once, retry using an idempotency key, wait for verified sandbox provider event, and reconcile the service entitlement.

PER-21.title: Import partner metadata without cross-label leakage
PER-21.journey: Import a synthetic partner file twice, merge deterministic identities, inspect only owned assets, and reject another label's identifiers.

PER-22.title: Reconcile an unmatched verified provider event
PER-22.journey: Inspect sanitized sandbox evidence, match it to one order, replay safely, prove no duplicate financial effect, and close the exception.

PER-22.title: Prepare and approve a refund with dual control
PER-22.journey: Prepare a refund, prevent self-approval, approve as an independent authorized actor, call only a sandbox/fake adapter, and reconcile final evidence.

PER-22.title: Export a minimal audited finance report
PER-22.journey: Filter a test period, export sanitized financial records, verify access audit and retention guidance, and attempt customer administration.

PER-23.title: Create a Live Session through publish readiness
PER-23.journey: Create session, book room, assign guests and staff, attach fake consent, complete production, approve edit, publish, and close reporting.

PER-23.title: Coordinate session collaborators safely
PER-23.journey: Invite fictional collaborators, track accept/decline, send scoped updates, remove one participant, and verify old access is revoked.

PER-23.title: Allocate production equipment and staff
PER-23.journey: Check availability, reserve camera and room, assign crew, resolve conflict, record custody, return assets, and close assignments.

PER-24.title: Complete public discovery and recovery with screen reader and keyboard
PER-24.journey: Navigate landmarks and headings, search, open details, trigger and correct errors, reach help, and return focus to the initiating control.

PER-24.title: Book a service without pointer input
PER-24.journey: Select service and time, enter delivery details, review price, submit sandbox checkout, recover from an inline error, and retrieve confirmation.

PER-24.title: Register for a course with accessible status feedback
PER-24.journey: Browse courses, inspect schedule and seats, register, resolve validation error, confirm seat hold, and retrieve registration status.

PER-25.title: Accept assignment and complete equipment custody
PER-25.journey: Accept assigned case, verify contents, record fake handoff, work offline, record late return, sync once, and close custody.

PER-25.title: Receive only relevant event-day updates
PER-25.journey: Open assigned event, acknowledge call time, receive fake operational notification, reject access to attendee details, and complete assignment.

PER-25.title: Use large controls under poor connectivity
PER-25.journey: Navigate assignment and custody screens with large touch targets, visible text status and intermittent connectivity without losing entered state.

PER-26.title: Take a Domo inquiry through quote and booking
PER-26.journey: Discover Domo publicly, submit consented inquiry, receive staff follow-up, accept authoritative quote, confirm availability, pay fake deposit, book, complete, and reconcile.

PER-26.title: Compare marketplace options on a limited data plan
PER-26.journey: Filter sale and rental listings, inspect total cost and availability, save one option, return from a web fallback, and retain state.

PER-26.title: Resume interrupted checkout without duplicate payment
PER-26.journey: Start checkout, lose connectivity after submission, reopen from another device, resolve authoritative order state, retry only when safe, and confirm once.
